items.title: settings_page() / runtime-policy cyclomatic complexity, plus a role-matrix group-builder production regression

items.description: settings_page() had grown to 501 lines / cyclomatic complexity 74 (28 returns, max nesting 6) from ~20 inlined POST form_action branches; a related runtime-policy module had similar complexity. A prior refactor (ffd822e) had also deleted a generic role-matrix group-builder function believing it dead/shadowed, which silently broke the role-matrix UI for every non-personnel domain in production (ValueError raised before any read/write, feature hidden -- not a security or data-corruption defect).

items.closure_reason: Extracted each POST-action branch into its own _handle_<action> function (17 total), preserving exact behavior including documented non-uniform quirks (double-commit, missing try/except, etc.); restored the deleted generic role-matrix builder verbatim from git history; added regression tests for 3 previously-zero-coverage actions found during the extraction sweep. Remote GitHub Actions (quality-gate + BYS360 Score 100 Quality Gate V1) reported SUCCESS against this commit, per user-supplied CI evidence.

items.title: PostgreSQL migration chain integrity gap
items.severity_reasoning: No live incident occurred, but an unguarded migration-chain integrity gap means the next deploy could silently corrupt schema state -- meets the P1 bar (deploy-blocking / data-integrity blast radius) even without a proven active break, same reasoning class as TD-036.
items.description: The Alembic migration chain had integrity gaps not caught before merge. A dedicated CI-enforced harness now proves empty-to-head, head-is-idempotent (a second upgrade is a no-op), and schema-introspection match against a real postgres:15 service container on every CI run.
items.closure_reason: Migration chain repaired and re-verified against a fresh disposable PostgreSQL 15 instance; CI wired to a real postgres:15 service container so the gate runs on every push. Remote GitHub Actions reported PASS for POSTGRES15_EMPTY_TO_HEAD, POSTGRES15_HEAD_MATCH, POSTGRES15_SECOND_UPGRADE, POSTGRES15_SCHEMA_INTROSPECTION, per user-supplied CI evidence.
